announcements.text: Longbow LLC, Orlando, Florida, was awarded a $419,607,961 cost-no-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price contract for fire control radar systems and post-production support services for the Apache Attack Helicopter (AH64D/E). One bid was solicited with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Jan. 31, 2032. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity (W58RGZ-27-D-A008).

contracting_activity.name: U.S. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama

extracted.description: Fire control radar systems and post-production support services for the Apache Attack Helicopter (AH64D/E)

announcements.text: Sigmatech Inc.,* Huntsville, Alabama, was awarded a $249,213,547 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for the implementation, integration, sustainment, and continuous evolution of Small Business Innovation Research Phase III capabilities that form a digitally enabled enterprise decision environment. One bid was solicited with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 25, 2036. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity (W9113M-27-D-A006).

contracting_activity.name: U.S. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama

announcements.text: Raytheon Co., Tucson, Arizona, has been awarded a $350,000,000 ceiling increase modification (P00014) to previously awarded contract (FA8672-19-D-0001) for Small Diameter Bomb II life cycle support (GBU-53/B). The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $950,000,000 from $600,000,000. Work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona, and is expected to be completed by Dec. 31, 2030. No funds are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, is the contracting activity.

fields.funding_text: No funds are being obligated at the time of award

contracting_activity.name: The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Eglin Air Force Base, Florida

extracted.description: Ceiling increase for Small Diameter Bomb II life cycle support (GBU-53/B)

announcements.text: Saab Inc., East Syracuse, New York, is awarded a $14,308,164 firm-fixed-price modification (P00026) to a previously awarded contract (N0001923C0049). This modification exercises an option for the production and delivery of one surface ship radar navigation (SPN-50) low-rate initial production unit in support of the Navy's shipboard air traffic control operations. Work will be performed in East Syracuse, New York and is expected to be completed in June 2028. Fiscal 2027 other procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $14,308,164 will be obligated at the time of award. This modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
